The error `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException: User not authenticated` was caused by configuring the Android Keystore key with `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)` in [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r3/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L31). Because no user authentication session was active when `cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key())` was executed, the Keystore blocked initialization of the cipher.

### Fix
In [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r3/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt):
1. Updated `key()` to set `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(false)` and removed `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)`.
2. Added handling in `save()` to catch any stale key that required authentication (`UserNotAuthenticatedException`), remove the stale Keystore entry, and reinitialize with the updated key.
